'''Eben Hopwil''' was an [[Asha'man]]. He was promoted to the rank of [[Dedicated]] and then Asha'man.

== Appearance ==
He was quite young, only sixteen, and was skinny with a big nose and ears. He had blotches on his face.
==Activities==
=== Dumai's Wells and the Seanchan ===
He was one of the first men on the farm.{{ref/book|6|3}} Eben participated in the rescue of [[Rand]] at [[Dumai's Wells]]. He was taken by Rand as an Asha'man bodyguard and he went to [[Cairhien]] with him after the battle. He was sent to Rand's force camped outside [[Illian]]. He helped destroy several outposts on the borders of Illian but was forced to flee when [[Sammael]] Traveled there and Channeled the [[One Power]] at Rand's army.

He gave news to Rand that the [[Seanchan]] invaded [[Amador]] and [[Ebou Dar]]. While there he was forced to destroy a Seanchan troop which contained a ''[[sul'dam]]'' and ''[[damane]]''. He had just recently been promoted to the rank of [[Asha'man]].

He went with Rand when Rand tried to deal with the Illian rebels loyal to Lord Brend.

He rode with Rand when Rand's forces attacked the invading Seanchan just outside Illian. On arrival back to Cairhien he accompanied Rand to his meeting with [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]].

=== Cleansing of ''saidin'' ===
[[Daigian Moseneillin]] bonded him as her [[Warder]]. Despite that they were bullied into it by Cadsuane, they developed genuine care for each other, however it was similar to the feelings of a playful aunt and her favorite nephew. He [[Traveling|Traveled]] with Cadsuane and Daigian to [[Far Madding]] to track down Rand. He then went with Cadsuane to meet with the [[Counsel]]s of Far Madding when they held Rand prisoner. He pretended to channel ''saidin'' in order to break [[Aleis Barsalla]] and set Rand free.

During the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]] he linked with [[Nesune Bihara]], [[Beldeine Nyram]], and Daigian. He was killed by [[Aran'gar]], a male [[Forsaken]] in a female body, when he detected him/her holding ''[[saidin]]'' and attacked her.{{ref/book|9|35}} Daigian is still in deep sorrow over Eben, refusing healing from [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] in order to cherish his memory.

=== A Symbol ===
Asha'man [[Jahar Narishma]] defiantly remembers Eben Hopwil as having died honorably defending his Aes Sedai to the Rebel's [[Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism|Hall of the Tower]].{{ref/book|11|23}}
